page.layout: One page of verse in a single column of italic lines, stanzas separated by blank lines; catchword "Bases" at the lower right, below the last line.

p.i: O, Rex tremende Cælitum, O, cerne, &t huius inferi Fathiscat orbis machina Tanto malorum pondere Oppressa. Cerne &t ingemens Iam liberari flagitet.
Vix portiunculam tuus Christus patentis obtinet Mundi, licet nutu suo Hæc cuncta Rex creauerit Supremus, omnia &̄ regat Creata mente prouida.
Per tot procellas &̄ truces Motus furentum protege Sacros potentior greges. Lupique Romani impiam Iustas ad iras concitus Vindex Tyrannidem preme.
Timete gentes improba, Horrete summum Iudicem. Deus, Deus &iuentium Furoris æstu flammeo Vos insequutus proteret, Vestrumque puniet scelus.
Hunc ante grandis machina Liquetur orbis totius, Et quotquot illam sustinent

page.notes: Catchword "Bases" is set at the right, below the last line, and is given in bottom_margin as well as the text ends with the last full line. Ornamental and stain marks on the scan are omitted. Some letters in the long-s and ligature forms (e.g. "&t", "&̄", "&iuentium") are uncertain and may be misread; "&iuentium" is probably "&iuentium" for "Iuuentium" with [?] not marked.
